user.title: Urmet intercom
user.description:
Connects to an Urmet Kit 1730 intercom over its local protocol.

**You need two things from the device**, both explained in the [setup guide](https://github.com/tjrmarques/ha-urmetview#1-get-your-auth-hash):

- the **Device UID**, printed on the WiFi module and broadcast on your network, e.g. `URMABB-700171-SMCYN`
- the **Auth hash**, 32 hex characters captured once from a real UrmetView app login. It cannot be derived from the device password.

Leave Host and Session port blank unless discovery fails — the port changes every session and is found automatically.

data_description.auth_hash: 32 hexadecimal characters. Capture it once from an app login (filter a packet capture for "username":"admin") and treat it like a password - it is static and can open your door.
data_description.host: Only needed if the intercom is not found automatically, or if Home Assistant is not on the same subnet as it.
data_description.port: Leave blank. The device picks a new one each session, so a fixed value goes stale; it is only useful for a one-off test.
data_description.allow_cloud: Discovery tries a local broadcast first, which works when Home Assistant shares a subnet with the intercom. Leave this on to fall back to Urmet's servers if that fails - it sends the device UID to them. Turn it off to keep setup entirely local; then set Host so the port can be found by scanning.
data_description.username: Always 'admin' on this device. Change it only if yours differs.

error.cannot_connect: Found the intercom but could not open a session. Another client may be holding it; close the UrmetView app, wait a minute and retry.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected this auth hash.
error.invalid_auth_format: The auth hash must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_uid: The UID should look like URMABB-700171-SMCYN.
error.not_found: Could not find the intercom. The local broadcast only reaches it if Home Assistant is on the same subnet - enter the device's IP in Host and leave Session port blank to scan for the port (up to a minute).

abort.already_configured: This intercom is already set up.

data.stream_idle_timeout: Release video after (seconds with no viewers)
data.ring_prewarm: Start video when the bell rings
data.allow_cloud: Use Urmet's servers to find the device

data_description.stream_idle_timeout: The video channel is released when nobody is watching, so the phone app can use it.
data_description.talk_repeat: Higher is more robust on a lossy network but uses more bandwidth. The official app sends about 12.
data_description.doorbell_tzsp: The ring is a cloud push, so it never reaches Home Assistant directly. If your router can mirror the device's traffic here (MikroTik: stream to this host as TZSP), rings become a local event. Off by default.
data_description.doorbell_tzsp_port: UDP port the mirror streams to. MikroTik's default is 37008.
data_description.ring_prewarm: The device does not send video on a ring - it must be pulled, which costs a few seconds. Enabling this starts the stream on each ring so a picture is ready sooner, but it takes the device's single video channel just as the phone app wants it to answer the call. Leave off if you still use the app.
data_description.allow_cloud: Discovery tries a LAN broadcast, then Urmet's rendezvous servers, then - if you set a Host - a local scan for the port. Turn this off to skip the cloud step, which sends the device UID to Urmet; discovery stays entirely local, but the port scan takes up to a minute or so.
data_description.quality: Affects bitrate and frame rate, not resolution - the stream is 960x240 in every mode. HD roughly doubles the frame rate.

open_lock.name: Release door lock
open_lock.description: Release the door lock on the active outdoor station.

open_gate.name: Release gate
open_gate.description: Release the gate on the active outdoor station.

select_station.name: Select outdoor station
select_station.description: Switch the camera to a specific outdoor station.

set_quality.name: Set stream quality
set_quality.description: Change bitrate and frame rate. Resolution is always 960x240.

talk.name: Speak at the door station
talk.description: Play audio through the outdoor station's speaker.

media.name: Media
media.description: Path or URL of the audio to play.

answer.name: Answer the call
answer.description: Start video and open the talk channel. Holds the device's single video channel until you hang up.

hang_up.name: Hang up
hang_up.description: Release the call and the video channel so the phone app can take over.
